Lemma
[Frame Homogeneity Implies Constant Sectional Curvature] 1. ch8:8.33Every frame-homogeneous Riemannian manifold has constant sectional curvature.

Proof

\sketch Frame homogeneity supplies an isometry carrying any chosen tangent $2$-plane to any other; sectional curvature is invariant under isometries.

□
